title: Asking for Directions – Everyday English Dialogues

lines.en: Excuse me. Can you tell me how to get to the post office?
lines.ko: 실례합니다. 우체국 가는 길 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

lines.en: I'm sorry. I don't know. I'm from out of town.
lines.ko: 죄송해요, 몰라요. 이 동네 사람이 아니라서요.

lines.en: Excuse me. Do you know where the post office is?
Sure. It's not far from here. Walk straight ahead until you get to Main Street. Then...
lines.ko: 그럼요. 여기서 멀지 않아요. 메인 스트리트가 나올 때까지 쭉 가세요. 그다음엔...

lines.en: Sorry to interrupt you. How many blocks is that?
It's about two or three blocks. It's the first traffic light you come to.
lines.ko: 두세 블록쯤 돼요. 처음 나오는 신호등이 그 길이에요.

lines.en: When you get to Main Street, turn right and walk one block to Broadway.
lines.ko: 메인 스트리트에 도착하면 오른쪽으로 꺾어서 브로드웨이까지 한 블록 가세요.

lines.en: Then turn left and go about half a block.
lines.ko: 그다음에 왼쪽으로 꺾어서 반 블록쯤 가세요.

lines.en: Which side of the street is it on?
Coming from this direction, it'll be on your right side.
It's in the middle of the block, next to the Sweets Ice Cream Shop. You can't miss it.
lines.ko: 블록 가운데에, 스위츠 아이스크림 가게 옆이에요. 바로 찾으실 거예요.

lines.en: Do you want me to repeat any of that?
No, that's okay. I've got it. Thanks a lot.
